class_definitions.EXPECTED_MECHANISTIC_DIFFERENCE: any other difference between two architectures that move the quantity the same way
class_definitions.MATCH: the two values are equal at the display's own precision (hemoglobin: within the repository's float-noise bound)
class_definitions.POTENTIAL_EDUCATIONAL_PROBLEM: the consciousness word differs by two or more bands, or one side reads Alert and the other does not
class_definitions.STRUCTURAL_CONTRADICTION: the engines disagree on the pulse, or on the DIRECTION a quantity moved (since the arrival, or since the first order's start after it)
class_definitions.UNRESOLVED: no comparable value (one side undefined, or the legacy engine has no counterpart)
